## Prototype-only controls

The artboard's *Prototype controls* panel (demo clock, journeys, world events, flags) has 0 bindings. It simulates the world and is **not** part of the app; equivalents are real (offline via NetInfo, map failure via Mapbox `onMapLoadingError`, language in Profile, rule changes via server re-evaluation, report review via Django admin).
